status: draft. Built from the forms and decks on 20 Nov 2026. Needs a review by the team, and Kushal for the recommendation bands.
how_to_read: Each applicant lists checks the system must pass. 'extract' values are what A1 must pull out, with the source. 'inconsistencies' are deck versus form gaps that must appear on the brief. 'flags' must be raised. 'allowed_recommendations' limits the headline recommendation. It is a range, not a single answer, because people decide. Severity follows PRD Section 19.0.
